pages.title: Turbomolecular Rotor
pages.text: Bladed discs spinning at ninety thousand revolutions per minute, so fast that gas molecules striking them are batted out of the beamline one at a time. It produces the ultra-high vacuum particle beams need. It whines softly and must never be touched while it spins.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Particle beams scatter off any gas. In the Planck-Scale Cutter I carved Neutronium Plate into blades, cooled with helium so they would not deform at speed. The vacuum improved by orders of magnitude.
Made in $(item)Planck-Scale Cutter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Turbomolecular Vacuum Pump.
